newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's November PMI index down at 52.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's November PMI index down at 52.8 pct.

text.p: Hungary's Purchasing Manager Index (PMI) was 52.8 percent in November, down from 57.8 percent in October, the Hungarian Association of Logistics, Purchasing and Inventory Management said on Thursday.
The following is a history of the index over the year on a month-to-month basis:

NOTE: The PMI is calculated using the same methodology as the United States' National Association of Purchasing Management Index. A figure above 50 indicates increasing economic activity, while a number below 50 shows declining economic activity.
